description:
Create a new SLD style named 'country_semantic_zoom' in the 'ne' workspace and apply it to the 'ne:ne_countries' layer. The style must implement semantic zooming:
1. When zoomed in (Scale Denominator < 35,000,000), render the countries as Polygons with fill color #E0E0E0 and stroke #333333.
2. When zoomed out (Scale Denominator >= 35,000,000), render the countries as Centroid Points (Circle, size 6, fill #FF0000). You MUST use a Geometry Transformation (OGC function 'centroid' or 'interiorPoint') to transform the polygons into points on-the-fly for the zoomed-out rule.

Log in to GeoServer at http://localhost:8080/geoserver/web/ (User: admin, Password: Admin123!).
